Rules in, then the speed back

A 0.x.0 release (shaded) adds rules and a new key: accuracy goes up and a parse does a little more work (0.5.0 +10%, 0.6.0 +6%). The point releases after it win the time back without changing a key (0.6.1, then 0.6.2). 0.4.0 also carried a speed change of its own, so it got faster.

Whole benchmark suite, whole address right (suite v1, 19,586 records)
